title: Write an unpacker for a documented binary archive format
prompt:
data/archive.pak is in our old in-house archive format, which docs/FORMAT.md describes. I need two things:

1. unpak.py, used as `python unpak.py <archive> <out_dir>`: it extracts every entry of any such archive into out_dir (creating sub-folders as needed), checking each entry against its CRC. A corrupt entry is still written, with whatever bytes could be recovered. Standard library only.
2. answers.json about data/archive.pak itself: {"entries": <how many entries it has>, "corrupt": [<names of entries whose CRC does not match>], "secret": "<the text of notes/secret.txt, without surrounding whitespace>"}.
